_note: Brackish price list. Proposal pages and the deposit checkout both read from this file. Prices in US dollars.

website-starter.name: Starter Website
website-starter.summary: Up to 5 pages, mobile-friendly design, contact form, basic SEO and analytics, 30 days of fixes after launch.

website-standard.name: Standard Website
website-standard.summary: Up to 10 pages, events or news section, donations or online booking, help writing page copy.

website-refresh.name: Website Refresh
website-refresh.summary: A new look and cleaner pages for your current site, on the platform you already use.

digital-audit.name: Digital Audit
digital-audit.summary: Written review of your listings, profiles, reviews and website basics, with a fix list.

digital-presence.name: Digital Presence Refresh
digital-presence.summary: Google Business Profile, social profiles, Apple Maps and Yelp cleaned up, plus a review link and QR code.

ai-session.name: AI Opportunity Session
ai-session.summary: 60-minute working session and a written list of your top 5 time-saving AI opportunities.

ai-quickstart.name: AI Quick Start
ai-quickstart.summary: 1–2 AI tools set up and working, plus a 1-hour team training.

care-plan.name: Care Plan
care-plan.summary: Updates, backups, uptime checks and up to 1 hour of edits each month.

social-essentials.name: Social Media: Essentials
social-essentials.summary: 2 platforms, 8 posts a month, content calendar, branded templates, monthly summary. 3-month minimum.

social-growth.name: Social Media: Growth
social-growth.summary: 3 platforms, 12 posts a month plus stories, event promotion, weekday replies, monthly check-in. 3-month minimum.
